title: QL-AntiDisconnectSpam
description: A lightweight and optimized plugin that prevents annoying 'disconnect.spam' kicks, keeping your players connected without causing server lag.
body:
# 🛡️ QL-AntiDisconnectSpam **Stop false-positive spam kicks instantly, with zero server lag.** [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/VERSION-1.1.0-00A8E8?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-antidisconnectspam) [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/MINECRAFT-1.8--26.2+-F4C300?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-antidisconnectspam) [![Performance](https://img.shields.io/badge/PERFORMANCE-HIGH--SPEED-FF3B30?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ql-antidisconnectspam) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/DISCORD-SUPPORT-7289DA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.com/invite/ZRe3RnubdW)
--- ## ✨ What is QL-AntiDisconnectSpam? **QL-AntiDisconnectSpam** is the ultimate solution for servers struggling with false-positive kicks. While it's primarily designed to stop `disconnect.spam` kicks, its highly customizable system allows you to **block ANY type of kick message** simply by adding it to the configuration. Unlike other workarounds, it intercepts packets silently, ensuring your players stay connected without sacrificing server performance or dealing with console spam. > 💡 **IMPORTANT:** > **Built for all versions:** Fully compatible with Spigot, Paper, and modern forks from 1.8.8 up to the latest Minecraft versions (26.2+). --- ## 🚀 Key Features * ⚡ **Elite Performance:** Coded for high-load servers (200+ players) with zero impact on TPS. * 🍃 **Ultra Lightweight:** Optimized packet interception logic with no unnecessary dependencies. * ⚙️ **Plug & Play:** Just install and it works. Includes a comprehensive `config.yml` for customization. * 📡 **PacketEvents Integration (Opcional):** Advanced packet injection to genuinely keep players online during massive lag spikes by resetting network timeouts. Requires PacketEvents plugin. * 🚫 **Log4j Spam Filter:** Absolutely eradicates hardcoded server warnings (e.g., "kicked due to keepalive timeout!") directly from the Java logging engine. * 🛡️ **Silent Prevention:** Stops the kicks safely and efficiently before they affect the main server thread. * 🔄 **Hot-Reload:** Change settings instantly without restarting the server using `/qlds reload`. --- ## 🧩 Commands & Permissions | Command | Aliases | Function | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/qlds reload` | `/antidisconnectspam` | Reloads the plugin configuration | `qlds.admin` | > ℹ️ **TIP:** > **No setup required for players!** By default, the plugin is automatically active and protecting everyone. The permission is only needed for admins who wish to manage the configuration. --- ## 🛡️ Why choose QL-AntiDisconnectSpam? 1. **Universal Compatibility:** Works seamlessly across older legacy versions (1.8) and modern versions (26.2+). 2. **Block Any Kick:** It's not just for spam! You can configure it to intercept and prevent **any custom kick reason** you want. 3. **Custom Alerts:** Optional notifications for players and console when a spam kick is successfully prevented. 4. **Active Support:** Developed by **Bastit**, ensuring standard quality and maintenance for the latest Java environments. --- ## 📥 Quick Installation > 🛑 **CAUTION:** > **Requirements:** Ensure your server is running **Java 8** or higher. 1. Download the version 1.1.0 `.jar` file. 2. Drop it into your `plugins/` folder. 3. Start your server and enjoy! --- ## 💬 Support & Community If you need help, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature, join our Discord server! [**👉 Join our Discord Server**](https://discord.com/invite/ZRe3RnubdW)
